correctness.rationale: Verified positivity and nondegeneracy of both 2x2 matrices, unique Perron eigenvalue coincidence by a strictly decreasing resolvent equation, monotone ordering of left/right Perron rays, exact spectral projector determinant identity and characteristic-polynomial root sign. Both limiting regimes and equality ray are proved. Exact rational vector identities and 12,000 reproducible randomized comparisons independently exercise the formulas; neither is used as infinite proof.

evidence: Protasov and Logofet (2014) prove eigenvalue constraints for a single rank-one-corrected nonnegative matrix, not the ordering of products of two corrected matrices.

Engen et al. (2013) study age-specific autocorrelation contributions and an illustrative recruitment model, but not a sharp two-pattern product frontier.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Broader spectral inequalities were checked for implication, not only matching terminology. The hypotheses of those inequalities do not imply a fixed sign for the present product ordering, which is proved to reverse once. Their known general tools may aid derivation but do not replace the new exact parameter classification.
